description:
To secure an alliance between the northern kingdom of Leracal and the southern realm of Arnata, the countries’ royal families agree to a political marriage. Tei, known across the frozen battlefields as the most fearsome warrior and monster hunter, volunteers himself as the kingdom’s hostage, trading his life as a warrior for that of a bride. In Arnata, Tei finds not the hostility he anticipated but the calm, steady gaze of Shuraka, the young crown prince destined to become both his spouse and future Padisha of the empire. For Shuraka to claim the throne, however, he must survive an uprising that threatens the kingdom - once that forces him to draw the blood of his own brothers. Moved by the courage and gentle integrity of his betrothed, Tei pledges to protect him at any cost…and in the quiet hours of a white night, two hearts caught between loyalty and longing begin to bloom.

(Source: Lezhin US)

After a one-night stand Hollywood top star Chase Miller, Joshua finds out he’s pregnant. As a single father, Joshua raises their child in secrecy. But when he is forced to return to work as Chase’s bodyguard, the two are reunited in a cruel twist of fate. Relieved that Chase doesn’t seem to remember him, Josh’s comfort is short lived - something primal, something desperate, yearns for the touch of his former lover, and every time he sees this beautifully twisted man, Josh’s heart races in spite of his mind. The more time passes, the more boundaries blur as instinct takes over… Will Joshua be able to resist the lips of his former lover? Or are the strings of fate too strong to resist?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: Master-Peace

unknown.title: เพียงสันติ

description:
Ju In-Cheol had it all...sharp suits, political connections, and a rising career as the trusted aide to Assemblywoman Lee Myeong-Seon, a ministerial candidate destined for power. But politics is a knife's edge, and one wrong move can send even the best men tumbling. 

When In-Cheol loses footing in the ruthless hierarchy of the office, he's handed a near-impossible task: resolve the explosive redevelopment dispute in Songmun City's Jungang District. Failure means exile. He's ready to do whatever it takes – until he meets An Pyeong-Hwa, the quiet gym owner next door and the key to the problem. Pyeong-Hwa's price for cooperation? 

*"Hit me. That's all I want."* 

Behind that strange request lies something darker than bruises. And as In-Cheol sinks deeper into the deal, he realizes every favor, every blow, is pulling him into a world where politics and pleasure share the same shadow. 

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

title: The Hounds of Sisyphus

unknown.title: The Hounds of Sisyphus～救いの先にあるもの～

description:
NotesThe dead no longer stay dead. They rise—not as monsters, but as aimless wanderers—plunging the world into chaos. Hope of immortality fades as disasters push humanity to the brink of extinction. Amidst the ruin, Pyo Guwon walks against the tide of fleeing survivors. On his path, he finds Heo Jinwoo, left for dead after an attack. Instead of passing by, Pyo offers a hand, posing a single question: "How does it feel to survive hell?" With that, he leads Jinwoo to a village where death holds no meaning—but in a world that refuses to let go of the past, survival is never that simple.

_Source: Lezhin_

## Notes
- This series is a global release, meaning all official translations come out on the same day as the original. 
- The official translations are uncensored, except for Japanese.

title: The Fallen Lamb
description:
In 1960s America, stoic and solitary ranch hand Dennis is hired for a summer of shepherding under a strange warning: trust nothing but the sheep. A month in, a stranger named Tod appears, claiming to be a hunter passing through. Though Dennis is wary, he finds himself slowly drawn to the man, unsettled by the pull between suspicion and desire. As the line between threat and connection blurs, tragedy strikes when a coyote slips past his guard and kills one of the flock. With loyalty shaken and feelings he can’t name, Dennis must choose. Will he hold on to his doubt, or take a chance on the one thing he’s been told not to trust?

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
Little A travels to a rural farm to reunite with the uncle who raised him only to find the place eerily silent and his uncle nowhere in sight. What awaits him is a chilling "bible" detailing how to care for the livestock… but something feels off. Because on this farm, the "livestock" aren’t animals they’re humans.

Now thrust into the role of acting farm manager, little A is forced to manage Mr. A’s Farm, a facility that produces livestock products using beast-like humans creatures who think and act like people, but are bred for their byproducts. Dark secrets plague the estate in the uncle’s absence. Little A must do all he can to keep the farm safe and sound...at least until his missing uncle, Mr.A, comes back.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

tags_v2.name: Tsundere
tags_v2.description: Characters who are initially cold, hostile, or prickly toward others (especially love interests), but gradually or occasionally reveal a softer, warmer, or caring side beneath their abrasive exterior. The term is a combination of "tsun" (ツンツン, tsuntsun, aloof or prickly) and "dere" (デレデレ, deredere, lovey-dovey).

tags_v2.name: Yandere
tags_v2.description: Characters who are deeply, obsessively in love, often to the point of violence, possessiveness, or psychosis. They may appear sweet, shy, or affectionate at first, but their devotion can lead them to extreme actions—including harming rivals, kidnapping, or even killing to protect or keep their love interest. The term is a combination of "yan" (ヤン, from yanderu, sick or mentally ill) and "dere" (デレデレ, deredere, lovey-dovey).

title: The Law of Immutability
description:
Woo-Ri Nam has always been the golden boy—wealthy, carefree, and untouchably lucky. But on the leap day of 2028, his 7th real birthday, everything changes. A seemingly harmless reunion with an old classmate, Su-Bin Shin, ends in a brutal murder. And then, inexplicably, Woo-Ri wakes up back in high school, right beside Su-Bin who has no idea that he just killed his deskmate. Trapped in a deadly time loop where almost every timeline ends with his death at Su-Bin’s hands, Woo-Ri becomes desperate to escape his fate. After multiple resets, Woo-Ri finally comes to the conclusion that the only path to survival may be ensuring Su-Bin’s happiness. With just one life left, Woo-Ri sets out to give Su-Bin the happiest life possible.

(Source: WEBTOON)

description:
Goh Yu-Min, the eldest son of an endangered black-footed wildcat clan, has never even met a female of his own kind and is doomed to a lifelong single status. Now freshly in heat and losing his mind to breeding instinct, he catches wind of a secret rumor: a male wildcat can perfectly pair with a human man and impregnate him without fail. Determined to continue his family line, Yu-Min sneaks into Hanguk University in search of the most beautiful and brilliant man he can find, and that is where he meets Beom Tae-Jun, a stunning senior with an irresistible body. Yu-Min sets aside his pride and desperately attempts to court him, only to end up pinned beneath Tae-Jun on his own bed. To his shock, Yu-Min realizes he is the one being “bred,” not the other way around. Even as he tries to escape, he finds himself addicted to Tae-Jun’s touch.

Can Yu-Min break free, or will he lose himself completely before he can secure the baby wildcat needed to carry on his family’s bloodline?

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: The Thread Never Burned

unknown.title: บ่วงรักข้ามภพ

description:
Jo Ji-Won is just your average college kid—well, except for the part where he scams people by pretending to be a shaman. Thanks to his silver tongue and some lucky guesses, he gains a reputation as a spiritual powerhouse. Unfortunately, word gets around… all the way to Jeong Tae-Oh, a superstitious mob boss who actually believes in that stuff. When Tae-Oh shows up demanding help, Ji-Won pretends to take the job—then immediately tries to run. Too bad he gets caught. 

He wakes up in a sketchy motel, staring death in the face. Thinking fast, Ji-Won blurts out: "Y-you need me as a talisman! To stay alive, we have to… sleep together!"

He’s sure a tough guy like Tae-Oh would bolt at the thought. Instead, Tae-Oh just shrugs.

 *"You should’ve said so earlier. Is once enough or do we need more?"*

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
Jeong-Cheol is a gambler, a failure, and now a divorcé after ten years of a marriage that finally collapsed. Before he can even catch his breath or curse his miserable luck, the very person who started it all returns to his life. Ji Min-Yeong, the ex-lover who terrified him, chased him, and yet was the one he loved more deeply than anyone else, appears without warning. Standing before him with the same chilling certainty as in the past, Min-Yeong whispers the words Jeong-Cheol fears most:

*“I will stay with you until the moment you die, Cheol."*

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: Shall I Write Your Love Letter?

Shall I Write a Love Letter For You?
Shall I Write Your Love Letter?
Should I Write You a Love Letter Instead?

description:
Employee-of-the-Month champion and service-industry all-rounder Lim Seongshik thought he’d seen everything, until he wakes up inside a bleak BL novel as none other than Elliot Brown, a minor villain doomed to die. In the original story, everyone meets their end at the hands of the protagonist, Arzen Theron. So Elliot decides to keep his past life as a writer hidden, lie low, and quietly avoid the one event that triggers the tragedy: ghost-writing a love letter. 

But life—and his cat—have other plans. A desperate situation forces him into becoming Arzen’s personal bed attendant, of all things. To make matters worse, his “secret identity” as a writer gets exposed to the novel’s original love interest. Before he knows it, Elliot is back to ghost-writing letters… this time for Arzen himself! But something’s off. The Arzen in front of him doesn’t match the cruel lead he remembers... 

Can Elliot keep faking those letters just enough to dodge his scripted death ending? Or has the story already started to change?

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
The F12 Center is infamous for one thing—its dangerously high superhuman burnout rate. And that’s exactly where civilian diagnostics officer Baek Shi-Jin is suddenly transferred. On his first day, Shi-Jin is approached by Jeong Tae-Yool, an A-rank Guide with a reputation as sharp as his instincts, under the guise of an admin worker.

 *“Just stop giving Ham Geon-Woo your attention, and we’ll get along fine.”*

Shi-Jin only wanted to repay Ham Geon-Woo, the Esper who saved him a decade ago. But somehow, his highest match rate is with Tae-Yool—who sees right through him.

 *"Doc, are you really using seduction to request a scan?”*

From then on, Tae-Yool seems to appear everywhere—especially when Shi-Jin’s in danger.

 *“If this were a real emergency, Alpha Team would be here to protect you in under 60 seconds.”*

What kind of ending awaits a sharp-eyed Superhuman and a guarded civilian doctor?

(Source: Lezhin US)

Ariana, born into a politically arranged marriage, was nothing more than a tool, used and abused by her family her entire life. title: War of Corpses
description:
Uce, a down-on-his-luck young man, dreams of becoming the champion in the brutal and legendary War of Corpses—a sport where necromancers and their knights battle for supremacy. In a desperate bid, he revives Eleonora, an abandoned corpse who claims to have been the deadliest mercenary alive. There are two big problems, though. One, Eleonora is alive — a fact that cannot be revealed at any cost. Two, she and Uce can’t seem to coordinate their movements. Can this unlikely duo overcome all obstacles, win the War of Corpses, and prove everyone wrong?

(Source: WEBTOON)

description:
Black panther Pyo Yoontae returns to So Jeongseo’s small town with one objective: to find his first love who had fur as white as snow. Being the school outcast, Jeongseo decides to help Yoontae in the hopes of finally making a friend. Besides, Yoontae’s first love surely can’t be Jeongseo himself, since he’s a weasel with brown fur. But something about Yoontae feels awfully similar to a forgotten childhood playmate, and there is one secret Jeongseo is keeping from him. Every winter, Jeongseo actually sheds his fur and turns snow-white! 

(Source: Tappytoon)

description:
Fresh out of the military and eager for a fresh start, Ji-Woo returns to university, ready to slip back into the rhythm of normal campus life. His plans hit a sudden, unavoidable roadblock when he is forced to enroll in a course taught by Professor Ha-Yeong. Ji-Woo absolutely dreads the prospect; he carries a deep-seated resentment toward her, stemming from a painful past where he was subjected to her blatant, unfair treatment. Forced to grit his teeth and endure her lectures, he prepares for a grueling semester of academic power games. However, the dynamic changes entirely when Ji-Woo makes a startling discovery: he accidentally stumbles upon a secret, private account managed by Ha-Yeong. Behind the facade of the strict, demanding educator lies a completely different personality, and as Ji-Woo peers into her hidden world, he finds his perception of his antagonist crumbling and his intrigue growing.

(Source: Lezhin US)

Lilliana is a neglected princess with a single mission: do not get pregnant. Ever since she woke up in a novel where she will die giving birth to the main character, Lilliana has known that her pregnancy will be her death sentence. Although they have married for political reasons, the ruthless emperor's fondness for Lilliana drives him to decide that his mission is to win her over. Thus begins the battle of wills between wife and husband. Will Lilliana be able to defy destiny and Helio’s affections?

title: A Gloomy Delusion
description:
*"Tae Seong-Jae... He’s the one who will take me back home."*

One day, without warning, I woke up as Seo Seung-Won, a character in a BL novel given to me by my younger sister. The aftermath of being transported into this world is brutal—I’m plagued with relentless nosebleeds, bouts of coughing up blood, and unimaginable pain. I discover that staying calm lessens the torment, so I desperately try to empty my mind and maintain my composure. But as my original memories start slipping away day by day, I spiral into despair. Still, I refuse to lose hope. To escape this nightmare and return to reality, I set my sights on the novel’s ending. Following the story’s flow, I resolve to become Tae Seong-Jae’s lover, face abandonment, and eventually fake my own death—all to achieve my goal of going home.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

title: Incomplete Combustion
description:
For weeks, a mysterious man has been setting Gyeol’s dreams on fire. By day, Gyeol lives a quiet life as a construction worker. But after locking eyes with a stranger at a job site, his nights are consumed by vivid, erotic dreams that leave him shaken - and wanting more. When he unexpectedly runs into the man again, reality begins to feel just as charged as his fantasies. The stranger introduces himself as Ye-Sung: handsome, magnetic, and impossible to read. His smile is too perfect, his gaze to knowing. He crosses lines without hesitation, drawing Gyeol into a game with no clear rules. As tension smolders between them, Gyeol finds himself spiraling deeper into Ye-Sung’s world, unable to tell where desire ends and danger begins. But play with fire too long, and one is bound to get burned.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: Mint Candy Love
description:
At first glance, Yeong-Han seems like an ideal boyfriend, with stellar grades and good looks, but he’s actually infamous for his awful temper. On the other hand, Yae-Joon is mild-mannered and polite, and he loathes people like Yeong-Han. As the two clash and bicker, they slowly wear down each other’s walls to discover their more vulnerable sides. Will this pretend relationship eventually turn into something more genuine?

(Source: Tappytoon)

description:
For his entire life, Chae Jeong-Hyeon has lived as nothing more than a shadow, an art restorer forced into the role of hidden ghost painter for his father, the celebrated Painter Chae. When the old master dies suddenly, Jeong-Hyeon’s long-nurtured desire for revenge dies with him, leaving only despair and the urge to abandon everything. But on the edge of surrender, a stranger appears: Yeom Tae-Hwa, a man caught between mortal and divine.

Tae-Hwa offers Jeong-Hyeon a bargain. Restore what has been lost and share his roof, and in return, he will grant Jeong-Hyeon the honor stolen by his father. Reluctantly, Jeong-Hyeon agrees, clinging to the fragile hope Tae-Hwa extends. Yet as the days pass, cold obligation begins to blur into fascination. Living side by side, Jeong-Hyeon is drawn closer to Tae-Hwa’s enigma… and to the haunting secret hidden within his 200-year-old silence.

(Source: Lezhin US)

tags_v2.description: Characters who appear cool, calm, and emotionally detached on the outside, but gradually reveal a warmer, more caring side beneath their composed exterior. The term is a combination of "kuu" (cool, 冷たい, tsumetai) and "dere" (deredere, デレデレ, lovey-dovey).

title: Once Upon a Deal
description:
Ju Yun-Seong thought getting a job at JH Soft was the start of a normal office life—until he noticed his cold, intimidating CEO, Baek Ha-Jin, glaring at him every time they crossed paths.

 *“Why is the boss always staring at me? Did I do something wrong on my first day?”*

Determined to avoid him at all costs, Yun-Seong keeps his head down… until he stumbles upon a mysterious employee ID and uncovers a secret: his boss isn’t just intense—he’s a nine-tailed fox. And to make things worse? Ha-Jin’s fox bead ends up lodged inside Yun-Seong’s body. Now the CEO won’t leave his side, and “normal” has left the building.

 *“Mr. Ju, you have two choices: stick close to me and do as I say, or I cut you open and take it back.”*

Excuse me?! Are those really my only options?!

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: How to Win over Your Crush

unknown.title: How to Win Over a One-Sided Love
How to Win Over Your Crush
The Secret to Winning Unrequited Love
Wie man seinen Schwarm für sich gewinnt
สูตรเผด็จศึกรักข้างเดียว

description:
At our high school graduation, the rival who had tangled with me for years suddenly confessed that he liked me. It was completely different from the victory I imagined, but still, I thought I had won. I walked away believing the score between us was finally settled.

That is, until years later, when he reappeared with a small child clinging to his hand.

A son.

Disgust and irritation flare up all at once.
A shameless fool… If his heart was going to waver that easily, why did he confess in the first place?

But fine. It doesn’t matter anymore. The past, his choices, the kid—none of it changes what I already know.

If I wanted to drag him back into my bed, it would be the easiest thing in the world.

In this bitter, twisted reunion, the line between victory and desire grows dangerously thin.

_Source: Lezhin US_

title: Mark of Fate
description:

Suspended from duty and desperate to support his family, he accepts a job guarding Cha Jin-Ho, an untouchable S-class Guide from the same privileged world he hates. description:
Feared by name alone, Shin Juhyeok never expected his toughest challenge to be... raising a kid? After rescuing a young hybrid named Lee Hae-on from an accident, Juhyeok planned to keep him around just until he recovered. Juhyeok can handle gangs and thugs, but nothing could prepare him for this: Hae-on’s first heat. Sweet, clingy, and completely unaware of personal space, Hae-on’s affection is anything but subtle. (Source: WEBTOON)

description:

description:
For years, Ho-Yeon has been targeted by creeps who mistake his gentle features for weakness. Somewhere along the way, he developed an unusual coping mechanism, turning the tables and forcing his pursuers into submission. The thrill of dominance becomes a habit, a preference, a dangerous kind of satisfaction. Then one day, Tae-Bum, a younger man with bold eyes and an even bolder heart, barges into his life with a straightforward confession. He is nothing like the others. No sleazy tricks, no clinging, just disarmingly pure affection delivered with calm confidence. Ho-Yeon, determined to scare him off, tries to push him away the only way he knows how, by attempting to take control forcefully. title: His Perfect Guide
description:
Yeon Hae-Geum, the nation’s one and only S-Class Guide, has been in love for years with Seo Moon-Hyeon - his guardian, mentor, and the man who raised him like family. From teaching him how to eat and read to mastering his guiding abilities, Moon-Hyeon has always been Hae-Geum’s everything. But just when Hae-Geum thinks he'll stay by his side forever, Moon-Hyeon suddenly announces his engagement… without even telling him. Crushed, Hae-Geum prepares to walk away... that is until fate throws in a twist: Seo Moon-Hyeok, Moon-Hyeon’s identical twin brother, shows up. Cold, blunt, and endlessly flirtatious, Moon-Hyeok needs Hae-Geum—not for love, but to power his climb to the top. Still, he’s not above using his twin’s face to seduce him. Now trapped between a possessive first love and a reckless new temptation, Hae-Geum must navigate a storm of emotions, pheromones, and dangerous attraction.

Will he remain loyal to the past—or give in to the thrill of something forbidden? One face, two destinies. One guide, caught in between.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

title: Kingdom of Innocence
description:
I opened my eyes underwater, then found myself in a dazzling palace straight out of a historical fantasy. There is no doubt about it, I have been isekai’d right into the world of a novel. And lucky for me, it is even the genre I loved the most, so I know all the rules. Or so I thought. While I am still trying to wrap my head around this ridiculous twist, I receive my main mission: help the story’s second male lead achieve his destined romance. Avoid curses, dodge questionable situations, fix the love plot, survive the chaos, all with my purity intact. 

Can I possibly complete this mission without destroying the entire story, or myself, first? 

(Source: Lezhin US)

But just as they’re poised to seize the biggest opportunity of their careers, fate throws them a curveball: a toddler named Hwan Beom-Hae, who, according to advanced DNA testing, is the biological child of both of them. Caught between disbelief and chaos, the two enemies are presented with an absurd yet high-stakes mission: raise Beom-Hae together, lovingly and responsibly. The reward? Exclusive construction rights to the largest global development project in history, sanctioned by the United Nations itself. But co-parenting isn’t exactly easy when you’d rather strangle your partner than share snack time and diaper duty. As Beom-Hae’s giggles and tantrums slowly chip away at their walls, Woon-Ryong and Pung-Ho must navigate tantrums, toys, and a growing sense of responsibility—not to mention some unexpected feelings. Can two lifelong enemies become the world’s most unlikely dream team dads? Or will their stubborn pride and unresolved tension bring everything crashing down? 

Enemies-to-daddies has never looked this chaotic—or this heartwarming.

title: Accidental Baby

unknown.title: アクシデンタル・ベイビー

description:
Doh I-Hyeon is the ultimate corporate workaholic, but he hides two secrets: he’s a somewhat defective omega and he suffers from prosopagnosia—the inability to recognize faces. After a blurry, drunken one-night stand leads to an unexpected pregnancy, I-Hyeon decides to keep the baby and brave single parenthood in secret. But his carefully constructed walls start to crumble when his superior, Seo Jeong-Un, begins a relentless pursuit. Jeong-Un is charming, persistent, and strangely familiar, but to a man who can’t recognize a face, his flirtations are just another workplace distraction. Can Jeong-Un break through I-Hyeon’s "iron wall," or will I-Hyeon’s condition keep the father of his child a mystery forever?

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
Yu Misol never thought a breakup would sting this much, especially when her ex dismissed her with the cruelest line:

*“Your breasts are too small.”*

Small? Please. She’s a full A, thank you very much! Still, the insult lingers, leaving her with one nagging fear: what if she dies without ever experiencing real passion? Enter Yoon Chawon, her childhood friend of twenty years. The boy next door who’s always been by her side. One teasing dare later, Chawon leans in with a husky murmur:

*“Misol, take it off. Let me be the one to really see you.”*

But things spiral further when Chawon’s bold friend, Jang Taegun, joins in, grinning as he growls:

*“A body this gorgeous, and no one’s touched it? What a waste.”*

Suddenly, Misol finds herself tangled up with not one, but two men who are all too eager to prove her ex dead wrong.

(Source: Lezhin US)

*Note: Part of Playtoon's Play Danpyeonseon (플래이 단편선) Collection.*

title: My Perfect Boyfriend
description:
Ahn Cha-Woo is the ultimate magnet for terrible boyfriends. Every relationship ends the same way, and the latest one does not even last six months before ending in betrayal. Why is love never on his side? Is it really too much to hope for a boyfriend who is polite, handsome, fit, and, well, generously endowed? Cha-Woo cannot help feeling the universe is being unfair. 

 *“Forget it. I am done with dating.”*

But just as he swears off romance, someone catches his eye, Nam Do-Ha, who happens to be polite, handsome, fit, and…everything else on his list. Of course, Do-Ha looks like the definition of a straight campus golden boy, so Cha-Woo quickly crushes his own interest. Until Doha suddenly lights up and says, “Wow, really? Then could you buy me lunch tomorrow?” A throwaway comment, taken seriously. Maybe, just maybe, this time will be different.

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:

The lingering spirit strikes a deal: she will leave Heemang alone only after fulfilling her final wish. Sarang died just one month into her first relationship, never having the chance to truly experience intimacy with her boyfriend. 

Before Heemang can protest, Sarang possesses her body and tracks down her ex, Choi Taemin, a popular, younger student celebrating his return to college after military service. In a bold, possessed frenzy, Heemang catches Taemin off guard with an intense kiss in front of everyone. Shaken and humiliated once the possession lifts, Heemang flees the scene. However, Taemin, who secretly admires assertive older women, finds himself completely smitten by the mysterious "crazy woman" who stole his heart.

description:

However, Kim Seon-Wu finds his heart sinking when he discovers that the senior he’s been pining for already has someone in her life. His jealousy flares toward Noh Sang-Yun, a fellow student with a rough, delinquent appearance who seems to be his primary romantic rival. The tension between them peaks during a reckless search for a local "haunted spot," resulting in Seon-Wu and Sang-Yun becoming stranded alone together in the wilderness. 

Seeking shelter from a sudden downpour, they break into a suspicious, dilapidated house, where Seon-Wu is unexpectedly possessed by a malevolent spirit. As his life hangs by a thread, Sang-Yun drops his rebellious facade and delivers a chilling ultimatum: "If you want to live, do exactly as I say from now on." Seon-Wu had no idea that this "thug" would soon become his literal lifeline.

title: Boredom Advisory
description:
Kwon Tae-Shin is a man worn thin by indulgence. A VIP at the exclusive members-only club Zeus, he buys fleeting nights with ease, yet never repeats the same encounter twice, forever chasing something that can cut through his suffocating boredom. Lee Won-Woo, a low-level club employee and the sole provider for his family, never expects to cross Tae-Shin’s path until he is assigned to drive him home one night. On a whim, Tae-shin makes him an offer that changes everything, proposing to buy a night with him instead. Stunned but tempted by the staggering amount of money, Won-Woo accepts, only to emerge from the experience shaken and regretful. He tries to avoid Tae-shin afterward, hoping to put it all behind him. But Tae-Shin is no longer bored. 

Fixated on the one man who managed to leave a mark on him, he begins to pursue Won-Woo with unsettling persistence, turning a single reckless decision into a dangerous and irresistible entanglement.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: Bloom in the Shadows
description:
In the hidden slums of Hong Kong, two rival powers dominate the underworld: The Grove Syndicate and The Lotus Syndicate. Their relentless territorial clashes plunge the city into chaos.

Song Ran, the underboss of The Grove Syndicate, is captured by members of The Lotus Syndicate but escapes, only to collapse in front of a modest flower shop. There he encounters Ja Woon-Young, the shop’s refined and gentle-looking owner whose presence feels strikingly out of place amid the shadows of the slums. 

What begins as a chance encounter soon grows into a dangerous entanglement. As the war between The Grove Syndicate and The Lotus Syndicate escalates beyond control, Song Ran becomes haunted by vivid, feverish dreams of fierce intimacy with Woonyoung. Drawn to him yet disturbed by the menace behind his beauty, he finds himself unable to resist. 

Beneath Woon-Young’s graceful smile lies a chilling gaze that conceals his true nature. Caught between desire and suspicion, Song Ran must uncover the secret of the mysterious florist before it consumes him entirely.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: When The Violets Bloom
description:
On a devastated Earth, the remnants of humanity dwell within the suffocating depths of underground bunkers, desperately preparing for a mass migration to a parallel universe. Su-Bin, a dedicated warp researcher, finds his only solace in his lover, Ki-Hyeok. Upon returning from a perilous surface expedition, Ki-Hyeok presents him with an impossible gift: a living, blooming violet. "It’s a miracle, Su-Bin! The Earth might finally be breathing again!" he exclaims, his eyes shining with newfound hope. It is Ki-Hyeok’s vibrant stories of the outside world that sustain Su-Bin’s spirit in the dim, gray halls of the bunker; for Su-Bin, this man is his solitary light and his only source of true happiness in a dying world. 

However, his fragile peace is shattered when Ki-Hyeok’s fellow soldiers arrive at the laboratory with grim expressions. They deliver a bolt from the blue—news so devastating it threatens to unravel everything Su-Bin believed about their future and his lover's survival.

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
For struggling idol Hana, a late-night variety show invitation feels like a golden opportunity. Sure, the program is infamous for its over-the-top content, but exposure is exposure... Right? With cameras and staff all around, what’s the worst that could happen? The answer comes fast and shocking. The hosts and fellow guests clearly didn’t get the memo about “professional boundaries.” Suddenly, the games and skits spiral into outrageous territory, the kind of risqué chaos no public broadcast should ever attempt. Hana can only stare in disbelief as the so-called “entertainment” blurs every line between performance and scandal. Is this still a variety show or some twisted after-hours experiment? And most importantly, are the cameras really rolling right now?!Between shock, embarrassment, and unintended hilarity, Hana is caught in the most unpredictable “broadcast” of her life. One thing’s certain: this is late-night TV like no one ever imagined.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: Acting Badly
description:
Veteran actor Cha Jae-Hwan has built his career on discipline and perfection. So when a close director friend asks him to star in the historical film Ja-Hwa, he expects a challenge, but not this one. At the first script reading, Jae-Hwan meets his co-star, Shin Seong-Hyeon, a rookie actor with raw potential but zero polish. His delivery is flat, his timing off, and his presence all over the place. For someone like Jae-Hwan, who breathes precision, it’s unbearable. Yet instead of walking away, he finds himself guiding Seong-Hyeon, patiently at first, then with a curiosity he can’t quite name.

“Shin Seong-Hyeon is an invasive species,” the director jokes. “You can’t control him. You just have to let him adapt.” 

But as rehearsals blur into something far more intimate, Jae-Hwan begins to wonder who’s really changing whom…

The performance, it turns out, isn’t just on camera.

(Source: Lezhin US, edited)

description:

At thirteen, he is entrusted with raising his nephew, Yi Nan-Yeong, a gentle boy with no talent for the sword and no expectations placed upon him. At first, Tae-Rok sees it only as duty. And Tae-Rok sees it.

In a court bound by rules, blood, and reputation, their bond teeters on the edge of ruin, where desire threatens to turn into something neither can undo.

title: The Secrets of A Eunuch
description:
To protect her brother, Hari enters the royal palace disguised as a eunuch. Despite her worries, life as a male court attendant turns out to be surprisingly peaceful. At least, until she is suddenly assigned to serve Prince Sohyeon, Lee Ryeong, known for his striking beauty and well known attraction to men, in his private chambers.

*“From now on, you will attend to the prince at night.”*

That very evening, Hari is ordered to help arouse the prince, a task she has no way of fulfilling. Her panic spirals, and in the chaos, her greatest fear comes true, her true identity as a woman is exposed.

*“You, you are a girl.”*

Now discovered in the most dangerous place possible, Hari must find a way to survive the palace, its secrets, and the gaze of the prince who holds her life in his hands.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: The One And Only
description:
Ten years ago, on an unusually cold winter day, Do-Eon’s father brought home a young boy. Given the name Mi-Yi, the child became Do-Eon’s younger brother in name, though they shared no blood. At eighteen, Do-Eon begins to care for Mi-Yi out of simple compassion, gradually becoming his sole protector and the only safe place in his world. Sheltered behind Do-eon’s quiet devotion, Mi-Yi grows up clinging to him as his one constant. Seven years later, everything changes when Mi-Yi is involved in a shocking incident that leaves their father at the bottom of a staircase. Haunted by guilt and secrets he cannot yet reveal, Mi-Yi asks only one thing of Do-Eon: not to hate him when the truth finally comes out. 

A story of protection that turns into dependence, The One and Only explores how love, guilt, and obsession blur when someone becomes the only person you have left.

(Source: Lezhin US)

The night takes a chaotic turn when Si-Yun accidentally splashes a drink directly onto her headpiece. Flustered and desperate to make amends, he reaches out to help her remove the damp accessory, but as his fingers graze the fur, he freezes. The texture isn't synthetic! It’s warm, pulsing, and inexplicably real. 

Noticing his shock, Ara quickly pulls Si-Yun away from the thumping music and prying eyes to a secluded corner of the bar. After a heavy, hesitant silence, she finally lets her guard down. She reveals the soft, snow-white ears that are a part of her very being, whispering a confession that defies all logic: "The truth is... I’m actually a real bunny."

description:
For her entire life in Joseon, Yun Jini believed there was only one man in the world, the king. As a newly appointed chambermaid guarding the royal bedchamber, she begins to awaken to forbidden desires she has never dared to name. But in a palace where love and freedom are luxuries no court lady can afford, her fate turns even darker. Accused of treason and forced to flee, Jini falls into a pond, sinking fast toward certain death.

*“I don’t want to die like this!”*

Her desperate plea is answered. The mysterious waters carry her not to the afterlife, but across time itself, into 21st-century Korea. Here, in a world bursting with freedom she never imagined, Jini experiences love for the very first time. Emotions long suppressed finally find release, and a woman who once knew only duty and fear begins to discover what it means to live... and to love.

(Source: Lezhin US)

title: False Awakening
description:
One day, Do-Ha appears before Do-Hun, calling him hyung as if they were brothers. But something feels wrong. Do-Hun soon realizes that this visitor is not human at all, but a figure pulled straight from the recurring dreams that have haunted him for years. Since Do-Ha’s arrival, strange and unsettling events begin to twist Do-Hun’s once-normal life. His own parents turn against him, he can never seem to get any rest at night, and the line between dream and waking starts to dissolve. As fear takes hold, Do-Hun grows convinced that the only way to end this nightmare is to kill the thing wearing his brother’s face. But when he finally confronts Do-Ha, the creature only smiles and murmurs, “You can’t get rid of me, hyung. It’s impossible. So let’s stay together forever.”

Now Do-Hun must face a terrifying question: is Do-Ha real—or just the reflection of his own fractured mind?

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
Raised under the harsh rule of an abusive father, Ju-ho has spent his life being compared to his perfect stepbrother, Hyeon-Wu. tags_v2.description: Characters who are deeply, obsessively in love, often to the point of violence, possessiveness, or psychosis. The term is a combination of "yan" (ヤン, from yanderu, sick or mentally ill) and "dere" (デレデレ, deredere, lovey-dovey).

title: The Genius Who Sees Through the World

unknown.title: The Genius Who Reads the World
The Genius Who Sees Through the World

description:
As a child, Shin Woo-Jin was kidnapped and locked away in a warehouse, forced to live as a slave. But against all odds, he was rescued and finally stepped into the outside world. Though free, Woo-jin wasn’t like other children. He had an extraordinary gift—the ability to read people. By observing the smallest facial expressions and unconscious gestures, he could see through their thoughts, emotions, and intentions with near-perfect accuracy. Like a profiler, like a modern-day Sherlock, Woo-Jin learned to navigate the world, one observation at a time. But for someone who sees too much, living an ordinary life is the hardest thing of all. All he ever wanted was a peaceful, simple life. But the world had other plans.

 *“As I thought… living a normal life is far too difficult.”*

(Source: Naver, translated)

description:
Twenty years ago, legendary player Lee Suhyeok was killed by a trusted friend during a tower raid. Now he’s back, reincarnated in a much weaker body and forced to restart from level one. Fueled by vengeance, he begins the climb again, but without money or his former abilities, there’s no way he can get his revenge… until he starts streaming. As his stats rise with his view count, Suhyeok turns his revenge into a viral spectacle that no one, not even his killer, will ever see coming.

description:
The thrilling counterattack of the female lead's friend against the fabricated female lead! The pitiful Mia, who served as the villainess protagonist's handmaiden, died after being wrongfully accused. That was Chae Mia's past life. Always standing by the villainess's side, passively watching her wicked deeds, running away simply because she was afraid... Deeply disillusioned by her own weakness, Mia hears an unknown voice...

\[If you could go back, would you make different choices?\]

 *'Go back...? Could I really change if I went back...? But... if I don't even try, I'll never change for the rest of my life...!'*

Mia resolved to return to her past life and change her actions. And so, she regressed to the very moment she first met the female protagonist who had tormented her.

 *‘I will absolutely live a life I can be proud of.’*

Right then and there, Mia's counterattack began. 

 *“The thrilling counterattack of the ‘female lead's friend’ against the fabricated ‘female lead’!”*

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title: Mugi Meokneun Seojanim

unknown.title: The Outcast Who Inherits the Weapons' Memories

description:
The peak of strength in South Korea is the Esteemed Martial Lee Clan. In that martial clan, Lee Cheol was looked down on and chased out because of his status as an illegitimate child. In order to survive, he lived in shadows, but he was chased down and killed because of his family's schemes. He was then granted a second chance—regression. Using his "ability to absorb the memories of a weapon" as a foundation, Lee Cheol would train and go down a path of struggle. Persistent competition and schemes regarding the right to inheritance, attacks from other races and monsters in dangerous, unexplored lands, and even local clashes related to his family's internal struggles... description:
I was transmigrated in a novel that was written by my older sister.
But.. the atmosphere of the novel is a little strange?

After My older sister got in a car crash, I was granted an opportunity to fulfill one wish in honor of her good deeds.

So I chose to become the character my older sister cherished the most in a novel.
I ended up possessing an antagonist named 'Satin', but the complications didn't stop there.. the main character 'Cain', the main protagonist who is a holy knight keeps interfering with me.

"Hey, why are you looking at me like that? It's giving me the creeps."
"Satin, just don’t talk to me. You might as well just go die."

Even though I was not really a big fan of novels.
I still tried to dig into the uncovered mysterious secrets of the novel, and play as the 'faithful villain'

But.. my relationship with Cain started to become deeper than anyone else's..
And now everything's spiraling out of control..!!

"Satin! I really thought you were dead... So, I was planning to kill everyone..." Kill? Seriously?
Who would have thought that as a child, he was actually like a little kitten — who was feisty and stubborn?!
This is really giving me a headache...

description:
In a world where monsters appear and the climate changes rapidly, the only place that maintains the form of a nation is the 'Special City'. There is the infamous esper unit 'Baekgun' that is dispatched to kill monsters and absorb the outside population. Baekgun's esper Shin Hwa-Jin lives being ignored because of his origin and weak abilities. Then one day, when he hears that his twin brother, a guide, was exploited and killed by his teammates, he goes on a rampage, kills his team, and jumps off a cliff. However, when he opens his eyes, he is in the 'Library' village where he is hiding from the Special City. Shin Hwa-Jin, who lost his memory due to the shock of the jump, is saved by Tan, a man who leads the library. Tan, who lost his home and family in the Baekgun's attack, dislikes Shin Hwa-Jin who speaks the Special City dialect, but he gradually grows affectionate towards him as he loses his memory and acts innocently, naming him Hima. As he spends time with Tan and deepens his feelings and contact, Hima gradually regains his original abilities...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

description:
*"A slave who knows things only a noble would…Who is this girl, really?"*

Lilliette, once the Empress of the vast Pardinas Empire, was killed by her lover and found herself reincarnated in the body of a nameless slave girl, roughly 17 years in the past. Choosing death over a life of pain, Lilliette provokes a noble and collapses. When she opens her eyes again, standing before her is none other than Slarhan Bentiac, her greatest political rival in her previous life. Now bound as a slave to the same capable man he was then, Lilliette begins a strange new life. 

But… why is this man unexpectedly kind and considerate to me? 

Determined, Lilliette resolves to use the knowledge from her past to help Slarhan become king for the sake of the empire and to take revenge on the lover who betrayed and killed her: Clid. 

(Source: Naver, translated)

unknown.title: The Courtship of the Monster Princess

description:
Sereniel was once a beautiful princess beloved by her people, until she was struck by a curse that disfigured her face, which led to her becoming known as the “Monster Princess.” Her parents shunned her and isolated her from the public, and the only person who treated her kindly was the knight Cassel. 

Sereniel had given up on her love for Cassel because of the curse. But one night at a party, she runs into Cassel, who has been drugged with an aphrodisiac, and they end up spending the night together. Forced by marry by royal decree, Sereniel is haunted by a strong sense of guilt that she had deprived Cassel of a happy future. Sereniel wants to free Cassel, so she asks him for a divorce. However, she received an unexpected answer. 

"I have no intention of letting you go." 

Sereniel believes that she will never be loved, and Cassel does not want to lose her. What will happen to their painful love affair? 

(Source: Comico, translated)

title: Kkaenggap
description:
A strange debt repayment began. Ku Tae-Gam, manager of the illegal loan company ‘Takatsu’. The only female employee, accountant Chae Hui-On. Change comes to them—supervisor and subordinate, nothing more, nothing less.

 *“My grandmother's hospital bills are three months overdue.”

“Look elsewhere. I can't lend you money even if you starve to death today.”*

He refused outright, but Tae-Gam couldn't stop thinking about Hui-On's unexpectedly vulnerable side, something he'd never seen before. Then, he rescued Hui-On from danger and they ended up drinking together. While Tae-Gam slept drunk, he was kissed like a thief in the night.

 *“......You, damn it.”
“Why are you cursing? Was it that bad?”* 

Only much later did he realize that kiss was a ploy to learn the office safe's password, but Tae-Gam couldn't bring himself to abandon Hui-On, standing on the edge of a cliff.

 *“Write this down. Don't miss a single word.”*

A wretchedly scribbled loan agreement on a scrap of napkin. Twenty thousand won a day. To be repaid in cash, no exceptions.

 *“I'll chase the bastard who borrowed my money to the ends of hell.”*

Each exhausting day only ended after exchanging twenty thousand won. Days piled up where he couldn't tell if he was repaying debt or accumulating it. Those days gradually took root deep within their lives.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

description:
Before I died, I was reincarnated into my favorite novel as Iena, a supporting character and an actress — a profession scorned in the Empire. After reincarnating, I had to “discipline” a few pests who kept bothering me. 

Then one day, the Crown Prince approached me with a strange proposal… 

“I heard there’s no man who doesn’t fall from just one of your gestures.” 

I think we’re imagining very different kinds of gestures here. 

“They say no one can meet your eyes when you smile.”

That’s because they’re scared of me…

“Use whatever means necessary to make the Duke fall for you.” 

Excuse me, Your Highness… I think you’ve come to the wrong person!!! 

The Duke is the male lead, and he already has a destined female lead he’s supposed to fall in love with!! I agreed to the Crown Prince’s plan, deciding to just hang in there until the real female lead shows up.

...but something’s gone off track? 

“Your Grace, desire isn’t inherently bad. If you want something, speak up confidently. But if the other person says no, you step back. That’s all it takes.” 

“Is that so?” 

“Yes.” 

“Then allow me to be bold. Iena, I wish to hold you.” 

…Are you being serious right now?

description:
For nine long years, the dynamic between them remained completely unchanged: Choi Yeong-Hyeon was the ruthless, unpredictable delinquent, and Lee Min-Woo was his submissive, personal toy. No matter how volatile Yeong-Hyeon’s moods became or how cruelly he pushed boundaries, Min-Woo always obeyed with a gentle, compliant smile. Staring into the eyes of his supposedly docile captive, a terrified Yeong-Hyeon is forced to face a horrifying truth: he was never the master of this game. Due to a bizarre spiritual affliction, Gyudam is haunted by ghosts and literally cannot recognize his former lover's face.

Reeling from the trauma that his beloved hyung has completely forgotten him, a distracted Myeongjin wanders into traffic and gets hit by a car. Now trapped in a state of out-of-body astral projection, his spirit appears directly before Gyudam, who can see the dead. Refusing to let his tragedy go to waste, Myeongjin desperately clings to his ex, wailing, *"How can I pass on to the afterlife without even getting to stick it inside me, hyung?!"*

_(Source: Lezhin US)_

And now... I've reincarnated into that very world. As who? Some nobody named Rudian. A literal background character with zero plot relevance. But then I stumbled across two game-changing companions: a weird, googly-eyed monster named Adi, and a cursed sword known as Diablo. If this world wants to be crazy? Fine. I'll go full crazy with it. It's time for the ultimate chaotic run, and this time, the so-called "extra" is flipping the whole story on its head.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

description:
Fifteen years ago, his father, fighting against unfair dismissal, took his own life amidst the indifference of a conglomerate. Before the shock had even subsided, his younger brother vanished without a trace. Faced with a series of tragedies, his parents ultimately passed away, leaving Do-jun alone. Since that day, when everything was taken from him, Do-jun has lived for revenge and truth. Realizing that he could not change anything without standing at the center of power, He endured his lonely days with the sole goal of becoming a politician. And on the day he finally received his diploma, he swore before his parents' urns:

*"I will find Yu-ri and bring her here to this very place."

"And those bastards...I will make them shed tears of blood."*

That night, Do-jun had his first "dream of the future." A vision too vivid to be a coincidence. And that dream foreshadowed the brutal path he would take in politics.

description:
Cordelia Vasquez, the eldest daughter of Vasquez, one of the eight sacred founding families is sold off to the Abram family for money. 

What awaits her is a constant cycle of mistreatment by her new life. One day, her unfaithful husband gets into an accident and loses all his memories. 

But his body is now possessed by none other than the legendary sorcerer, Leonard Atrey, who was supposed to be dead. Seeing this as her golden chance at freedom, Cordelia immediately shoves divorce papers at Leonard. However, he refuses, saying, "If you want my signature, you have to do what I say." 

Feeling the deal is unfairly stacked against her, Cordelia counters by saying that she’ll keep his secret if he agrees to become her mentor. Leonard repeatedly tries to refuse, but her pitiable situation finally breaks his resolve. They forge a contract as master and apprentice. but while her husband’s memories are gone, Cordelia’s scheming mother-in-law and her brother make their move to seize control of the family. 

To stop their schemes and to take revenge on Maximilian, the man who murdered Leonard…both of them decided to set off together fulfilling that goal.

title: Hyeongpyeoneomneun Mereuhen
description:
Late spring. The streets of Hongseong were soaked and bustling under the weight of the season. Exhausted and emotionally drained under her parents’ contempt and coldness, Seo-Hee crosses paths by chance with a notorious playboy known for his promiscuity.

 *"Ah... I didn’t mean to take it this far."
"Guess I’ll be staying the night."* 

A man who freely drifts between tenderness and rudeness. A man who treats people like fleeting amusements. A man who scoffs at the idea of a beautiful fairytale, calling it a hollow illusion , Joo Tae-Baek. Wrapped in brilliance and danger, he crashes into Seo-Hee like a violent wave, shaking her to her core.

 *"Okay. I’ll keep your secret."
"...You mean it?"
"Sure, if you let me rock your world once, nice and loud."*

A dirty fling. A fleeting rush. "No need to overthink it." She thought if she let herself be consumed by him, even a false love might be better than nothing. And so, she willingly threw herself into the fire, a lighthearted affair that was anything but; Was she out of her mind? Who the hell taught her that this was how you seduce a man?

 *"So... we’re done now, right?"*

Seo-Hee tilted her head slightly toward the completely dazed Tae-Baek. 

*"I need to be gone before midnight."* 

So then... Who really got burned in the end?

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

His only joy in an otherwise dull and unchanging life is the online game God-Forsaken World. To him, it’s more than just entertainment—it’s an escape from reality. Then one day, while immersed in the game, he hears a mysterious voice from nowhere. When he comes to... he finds himself inside the world of the game! You’d think that after being transported into a game, he would become a cool, powerful protagonist... but no. He wakes up as the Empire’s disgrace and failure of a third prince: Gilroshan Elro de Valt. And if things couldn’t get any worse, the moment he opens his eyes, someone tries to kill him! Trapped in the body of an overweight, pathetic prince scorned by all, the protagonist has one secret weapon—a strategy guide, the key to survival that only a veteran player like him possesses! unknown.title: [Colorful Night Short Story Collection] The Dragon King's Favor
Sự Sủng Ái Của Long Vương

description:
"You little worm." 

That's what Yeon's master always calls her. Yeon is a water snake, and her master is the Azure Dragon, the guardian of the East. A pure-blooded dragon who valued lineage and station above all else. 

"You know you'd die instantly without me, don't you?" 

A water snake's typical lifespan is only 10 years. The reason why Yeon has lived for over 100 is because the Azure Dragon shares his life force with her. And so Yeon has no choice but to serve him well, whether she likes it or not. Until one day, while undressing the heavily drunk Azure Dragon, he pushes her into a one-night stand. Of course, it happened while he was so intoxicated that the damned dragon doesn't remember a thing. But then Yeon finds out that she's pregnant. 

If the pure-blood Azure Dragon finds out that a worm, no, a water snake, is bearing his bastard child, he will surely kill them both. What should she do? 

She has to hide it. She has to hide that they slept together and the pregnancy. But the more she tries to hide, the more the dragon becomes suspicious of Yeon. 

"Whose child are you carrying?" 

Finally, Yeon's pregnancy is discovered…! 

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Notes:
\- Includes one extra chapter.
\- Part of Haewadal Studio's Saegya Danpyeonseon (색야 단편선) Collection.*

description:
Erina, the only daughter of a huge merchant corporation, lost her voice completely after the shock of losing her mother, and her childhood friend Noel, whose growth has stopped due to a curse and who remains in the form of a boy. For 15 years, the two lived like a family, and Erina was only able to speak to Noel. One day, Erina, who believes in the superstition that "if you kiss a man of the opposite sex on the day before your 20th birthday, you will be happy for the rest of your life," kissed Noel, but the next day, Noel was in his adult form! This incident triggered Noel, who had originally had feelings for Erina, to grow even more obsessed with her...!

 *"I wish she would choose me instead of the other man..."*

A status-disparity romance that begins with a kiss between a young lady who has never known true love and a secretary who can't stop doting on her!

(Source: Comico, translated)

Hui-Su, who has been single for 24 years and has grown up normally, finally has the love she has always dreamed of, but her fantasy is shattered by her first sleep with her boyfriend. So, she goes to a lesbian bar with her lesbian friend Jae-Yeon while drunk and meets Ju-Hui there. They are attracted to each other and end up kissing. Hui-Su feels confused about her sexual orientation and feels guilty about her boyfriend. 

Confused, Hui-Su visits the lesbian bar several times to meet Ju-Hui again, and finally meets Ju-Hui again. Just before the two leave the motel and head out, Ju-Hui sees her boyfriend's KakaoTalk message on Hui-Su's phone. Ju-Hui, dumbfounded, leaves. Hui-Su thinks she left because she couldn't do it, and breaks up with her boyfriend because she feels sorry for him. However, Joo-Hee already misunderstands that Hui-Su is still dating her boyfriend. Even while in a relationship with her FWB, Min-Young, Ju-Hui continues to be concerned about Hui-Su. 

Will Ju-Hui and Hui-Su be able to properly convey their feelings to each other? 

(Source: Lezhin, translated)

title: Sunsuhaji Motan Jaehoe
description:
For five years, did you have fun without me? 

There was one thing my husband, Joo Tae-jun, said to me on our wedding day. 

“…Smile. You got what you wanted, so why the long face?”

 Our marriage, built on nothing but cold calculations and a contract, felt like an endless, dark tunnel. Then, at the end of that tunnel, like a ray of light, a child came into my life. But I had no choice but to run. There was no way my child could grow up safely in a household where treating people like objects was the norm. So, I left him with a lie—that I had found another man. 

Five years passed. 

And then— 

“Five years. Did you enjoy yourself?” 

The moment I heard his voice, my whole body froze. 

“You should’ve at least made the most of it with that bastard before I found you. But that won’t be an option anymore.” 

I forced my stiff body to turn—and there he was. 

“My turn now. This time, I’m never letting you go.” 

My ex-husband. My first love. The man I once left behind.

description:
For over four years, Shayla has served as the personal maid to Judith, the troublesome youngest daughter of the prestigious Kalley Count Family. Her predictable routine is completely upended when the heir to the estate, the eldest young master Cedric, returns home. Taking charge of his sister's chaotic education, he approaches Shayla with a shocking and archaic proposal: to become Judith's "whipping maid," absorbing the physical punishments earned by the lady. 

 *"The duration will be three months. For your services, you will receive an additional salary equal to your current maid's wages."* 

The offer of a double salary is too tempting to refuse; it means reaching her secretly guarded financial goal much faster. Greed overcomes her hesitation, and she accepts the contract. However, reality hits her brutally during their very first session when Cedric commands coldly: "Lean against the fireplace and bare your backside." Only then does Shayla realize her grave mistake. She hadn't accepted a lucrative job, she had walked straight into his carefully laid trap.

description:
*"Yeon-woon, want to sleep together?"*

One summer night, a single mistake shatters the bond between inseparable friends and roommates Cha Jae-han and Kang Yeon-woon, leaving them estranged for nine long years. Now, just two days into his internship at Haeo Planning, Yeon-woon runs into Jae-han again. Though Yeon-woon still despises him, Jae-han keeps reappearing in his path, impossible to ignore.

“…Hello. I'm Marketing Team B's intern Kang Yeon-woon.”

Yeon-woon’s lips tremble with the effort of forcing a polite smile. Jae-han lets out a quiet laugh at the sight. The once-innocent, awkward boy had grown into a man.

*“Congratulations on joining the company. Let’s see each other often from now on.”*

Jae-han extends a hand, smiling with ease. At the sight of that broad palm, Yeon-woon’s chest tightens as the memory of being pulled by that same hand nine years ago creeps back in. His stomach churned.

description:
Two families who loathe each other to the core: Vermonte and Temnes. Clodel becomes the sacrificial offering for a forced reconciliation, marrying Kaian, the Duke of Temnes. “So you’re a bride unwelcomed by Temnes. Know your place and walk in on your own feet.” Kaian treats her coldly, as the heir of a family locked in long-standing hostility. “How admirable. Selling yourself to a man from your enemy’s house because of starving children.” For him, it was an unwanted marriage. For her, it was a marriage she chose. Clodel endured the humiliation poured upon her— she had not come here ignorant of what awaited her. Between the two, a fragile bond of husband and wife begins to take root. Gradually, he grows obsessed with Clodel, and she finds a reason to live in Kaian. But a shallow, unstable relationship is easily shattered and ruined. “It’s disgusting—mixing such filthy blood. It’s not like you can split a child in half.” Upon learning her husband’s true feelings, Clodel leaves him behind.

(Source: Naver, translated)

description:
*"Once you're in, the only way out is death!"*

Former hitman Jeong Do-gyun thought he'd left that life behind. Now retired, he keeps a low profile, working at a café run by Gu Sang-hyeok—the closest thing to family he has following their days spent in an orphanage. But one day, Sang-hyeok vanishes without a trace. Following his trail, Do-gyun finds himself on a remote, mysterious island—only to discover a horrifying truth. The island is a prison, filled with kidnapped victims forced into slavery, watched over by merciless killers. And to make matters worse, the man who murdered his family is here, too. With a vengeance burning in his veins, Do-gyun prepares for the fight of his life. It’s him against an army of ruthless assassins—only one side is making it out alive.

(Source: Naver, translated)

title: Kim Sangsa Jugigi
description:
A war that took place in a tropical country, a jungle war. In this war, the Korean army sent troops to fight, and many soldiers were killed and died in battle. As time passed, the long war began to come to an end. Most of the soldiers returned to their homeland and adapted to society, but some were different. The soldiers who had adapted to the slaughter and became broken could not live in society. They gathered in a large building like the Kowloon Fortress on the outskirts of the city and lived relying on each other. Just as the war was ending. A monster of jungle warfare. Sergeant Kim of the 1st Platoon of the White Tiger Battalion. For some reason, he gathered his platoon members and raided the house of the company commander, Captain Seo. Sergeant Kim broke down the door and entered, and after a fierce battle with Captain Seo, he killed the captain. However, Captain Seo's son was hiding in the closet, and he could only watch his father being killed. Now, 20 years later, Sergeant Kim was reigning over the broken soldiers in the Kowloon Fortress. His platoon members were also soldiers who had been flying and crawling, so they each took a position as executives.

A world without war was empty and free to them. And then one day, Captain Seo’s son came to visit him in the closet. His goal was clear. To kill all the people who killed his father that day, and Sergeant Kim.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

description:
“My child, where are they right now? Give them back. My child.”  
“My child?”  
Setting foot on Korean soil again after four years. Facing my ex-husband for the first time in five years. Who would have imagined it— that the first thing he’d do after five years would be to take my child away.  
“Yours and mine. Our child.”  
He closes the distance, so close his breath brushes the tip of my nose. His sharp gaze digs into me as if he’s tearing me apart.  
“Come home.”  
“…What?”  
“Yoon Soyeon, come back to where you belong.”  
When was it that he threw me away so coldly? And now he’s telling me to return… to resume our married life. After everything I had to forget. Everything I forced myself to ignore…  
“You need to become my wife again.”  
But why… why does my heart race when he says that? A married life resumed after five years apart— Can we avoid failing this time?

“It’s fine. I’ll overlook your reckless behavior—just this once. Of course, it’ll be the last.”

description:
Ban Yeon-Ha, troubled by debts, makes a proposal to her boss and long-time hidden crush.

"Are you sure you can accept my conditions?"

"All of it?"

"Am I some sort of cuck? Give money to the mother of my child only for her to fly away?"

title: Dalbit Sequence
description:
"Hey, dating me is seriously a steal."

"No, hngh. Once I pay off all my debt, then..."

"You're gonna just drop dead?"

Nod, nod, I nodded my head at Gu Taehwi's words. That's right. Once I cleared this damn mountain of debt my dad left behind, I planned to just drop dead. And with a completely peaceful heart.

If I died leaving behind debt, I didn't know who my debt would torment next. Mom, aunt, uncle, niece/nephew. Those gangster bastards think anyone with shared blood is family. I didn't want to be a nuisance even in death. While I was frowning with such serious thoughts, Gu Taehwi, who was stuck to my back like glue, snorted.

"Bullshit. I'll pull you out of hell." 

"Ah…. Hngh, why hell?" 

"Then what, you expected a bitch who's messing around with a gangster to go to heaven?"

description:
Samdol, a woodcutter known for his strange bad luck — his clothes always end up torn — is saving money to buy an expensive silk outfit said to never rip.    

One day, while working in the forest, he rescues a deer being chased by a hunter.    

As a token of gratitude, the deer leads him to a mysterious hidden pond — the secret place where celestial fairies bathe.    

After an unexpected accident, the fairies hurriedly return to the heavens, leaving behind only one of them, Danhwa, who has lost her celestial robe and can’t go back. With no other choice, Danhwa ends up staying at the woodcutter’s house.    

However, to make matters worse, she enters the “mating season that comes to celestial fairies once a year” and begins to throw herself at Samdol.     

And so begins a cohabitation filled with misunderstandings, magic, and situations as amusing as they are dangerous.

“Adrian. Call me whatever you like.”*

title: Huigu
description:
Dreaming of a happy family with his fiancée, Hui-Kyung, Lee Yoon-Woo moves to a quiet, rural village where he has no connections. But one day, Hui-Kyung leaves home, leaving only a short text message saying goodbye. Abandoned by his fiancée and struggling to adjust to his new school, Yoon-Woo is struggling when her younger brother, Chae Jeong-Min, his first student and a friend from their college days, shows up... 

*"Hello, teacher. It's been a while."

"Oh, not teacher... Should I have called you brother-in-law?"*

Despite Yoon-Woo's protests, Jeong-Min invades his precious home, which he hadn't even cleaned, fearing any trace of Hui-Kyung would disappear. He then rummages around, proposing to live together...

 *"I have no one to turn to, so I'm just chasing after my ex-girlfriend who left me."*

Yoon-Woo and Jeong-Min cannot refuse, but will their cohabitation be ok?

description:
Every summer, she suffers nightmares of snakes slithering into her home. Like a dream that pursues her even when she flees, the past she believed forgotten knocked on her door once more. Having lived as a cold-hearted lawyer in Seoul, she returns to her hometown, Geumnak-ri, after 11 years, using consulting on a redevelopment association dispute as her excuse. A figure standing on the opposing side of her client, and simultaneously the one who left an indelible wound on Hui-Jae. Every time she faced him, Hui-Jae was overwhelmed by scenes she couldn't tell if they were dreams or memories. Red roses, an old side door, a school uniform, and the low voice that called her name.

title: Until You Say My Name Thrice

unknown.title: Until You Say My Name Thrice

description:
At the tender age of five, Shin Jae-Won first met Park Sang-Eon at his parents' funeral. Taken in and raised together, Jae-Won’s gratitude eventually blossomed into a deep, secret yearning by the age of fourteen. At twenty, fueled by liquid courage, he finally confessed his feelings—only for a miracle to occur. His love was reciprocated, and Jae-Won believed he had secured a lifetime of domestic bliss with his incredibly devoted and skilled lover, a man fifteen years his senior. 

However, the fairy tale shattered at age twenty-seven when Jae-Won spotted Sang-Eon in a place he should never have been. The man he thought he knew was gone, replaced by a stranger shrouded in secrets. Staring down the man who had been his entire world, Jae-Won demands the cold, hard truth with a trembling heart: "Explain yourself. From the very beginning. Everything." Their lifelong bond now hangs by a fragile thread.

(Source: Lezhin US)

description:
Kim Jae-Han, a brilliant and ambitious young magistrate newly appointed to the Sangju district, arrives with a hidden agenda that threatens the local status quo. Shortly after his arrival, he crosses paths with Choi Yeon-Ho, the eldest son of the powerful and influential Choi clan. Despite his lineage, Yeon-Ho lives a miserable existence as a social outcast held in utter contempt by his own family. Jae-Han finds himself strangely drawn to the innocent, suffering soul hidden beneath Yeon-Ho’s ragged exterior, and he begins to offer the young man a rare, genuine kindness. 

For Yeon-Ho, this handsome magistrate is a beacon of light in a lifetime of darkness; he falls deeply in love with the first person to treat him with dignity. However, their burgeoning bond is built on a precarious foundation. Unknown to Yeon-Ho, Jae-Han is meticulously orchestrating a plan to dismantle the corrupt Choi family entirely, placing their hearts on a collision course with tragedy.

Confined for 1 Year for 100 Million Won, Deal?
Getting 100 Million for Being Locked Up for a Year - Possible?

description:
Late one evening, a large sum of money was transferred into her account.

*“Any questions about the transfer? Talk to the bank directly! That's all I'm saying!”*

There was no way he could just give it back. It wasn't that he wanted to pocket someone else's money—that's just how the world works these days. Did you think I'd fall for voice phishing? But the moment the shadowy group stormed into her home, Song-Yul realized something was terribly wrong. One man stood out distinctly from the rest. Model-like tall stature and striking features. Even his loosely worn suit seemed charming, such was the intensity of his presence. He delivered his demand to her in a cold voice.

*“One hundred million.”
“Yes? Yes?”
“I'll give you 100 million won if you stay locked up like a corpse for a year.”*

A year of confinement for 100 million won? It's far more dangerous than expected, and far sweeter.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

title: Yuusei
description:
Kim Min-Su, a 35-year-old salaryman at an ordinary company, lives a monotonous life. He has a girlfriend, but his days blur together as he endures a borderline-abusive boss and trudges through work. One day, while on a date, he runs into a middle school classmate. Luxury car, beautiful partner, glamorous lifestyle: everything Min-Su isn't. Consumed by feelings of inferiority, he impulsively makes an investment that, against all odds, becomes wildly successful. Now a multimillionaire, he reinvents everything: his job, his relationship, his home. A new life begins. Yet somehow, the dream life he's obtained feels strangely hollow. Then, out of nowhere, a young girl appears claiming to be "Min-Su's daughter". What is her true purpose? And what lies ahead for Min-Su? 

(Source: Piccoma, translated)

title: Rhythm and Baseball

Now, they've set their sights on returning to the professional ranks—a comeback everyone says is impossible. They've resolved to run the bases once more. To become useful people, simply to retire as ordinary players.

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title: Jeopjungjindam
description:
A woman who was once the cherished daughter of a noble household, Hong Yeowon, loses both of her parents in an accident and falls into hardship. At that moment, a familiar man appears before her. His true identity is Choi Geonyul, the childhood fiancé once promised to her, who earnestly begs Yeowon to let him stay at her workshop. But there was one thing Yeowon had overlooked: she was currently making a living by carving “intimate objects.” 

“Do you know what this is used for?” 

“I heard it’s something they use in the pleasure houses. Married couples use it too…” 

“Exactly. But do you know where and how this goes in?” 

“Goes… in?” 

After Geonyul accidentally discovers the “works” she barely managed to scrape by with, he makes her an unexpected proposal, claiming he can help her earn much more. 

“I’ll show you mine.” 

“What?” 

“I’ll show you, so you can take a cast of it and work with that.”

The moment he was bored while holding the camera— delicate fingertips, eyes that you can't take your eyes off, overwhelming melody. His eyes, his heart, stopped at the man playing the piano on stage. *"Please be my photo model!"*

Track down the fanatics and bring peace back to the world.

"How am I supposed to save the world in a three-year-old’s body?!"

The order is on the verge of collapse.
I rescued the pitiful protagonist of the game...
only to somehow end up taking his place.

Now I’m the Pope.
But this place is crawling with fanatics secretly worshiping an evil god, and spies from the royal court.

Even the holy knights who are left... have completely lost it.

"Daddy! Call me Daddy, Master!"
"I told you, I’m the Pope, not Master!"

The problem?

And even the male lead I let go so he could live a happy life...

"As long as I have you, I don’t care if the world burns."

...seems to have come back not quite right in the head.

Can our crumbling order really survive and bring peace to the world?

title: Myeong-Tae-ui Sajeong
description:
Heo Myeong-Tae, a middle-aged man in his 40s, is constantly scolded by his wife for his early arrival (!). He habitually laments his situation at his local pub, only to end up drunk. Unintentionally, news of Myeong-Tae's plight has spread throughout the neighborhood, and everyone knows about it. The pub owner, feeling sorry for Myeong-Tae's exhaustion, orders his next-door neighbor and pub worker, Go Woo-Ju, to leave work early, citing his responsibility for Myeong-Tae's return. At home, where he has lived for years, he hears his wife's complaints, and at his part-time job, he hears Myeong-Tae's lamentations. It's all exhausting for Woo-Ju, who has simply offered to help Myeong-Tae with his sex life... But this middle-aged man is anything but ordinary!

A crazy romance between a humble and insignificant 40-year-old who has just embarked on a sacred journey and a young man in his 20s who meets someone he likes!

When she was twenty, she quietly kept Seokjoo in her heart. Now, she was face-to-face with the man who had once left without a word.

"Director."

"Drop the formalities. Call me like you used to."

"...Sunbae."

"When I was assigned to your office, was this what you had in mind?"

"No."

"Then why, all of a sudden..."

If he touched her now, he’d lose all control—and he’d make her cry. So he waited. Just a little longer. At his own pace.

"How far are you planning to go with me?"

With Yoon Jiwon... how far?

I'll just take you.

Again.

description:
The Silent Don has returned to modern-day Korea!
The quiet man has another face—
Jo Yongde, who works in the product development department of a cosmetics company, is clumsy and constantly failing at everything he does, making him an annoyance to those around him. Even when he gives a presentation in front of the company president, he only ends up making a fool of himself, leaving his manager and colleagues exasperated.
The only one who warmly reaches out to him is his teammate, Sear.
However, Yongde has another identity—he is the only son of a crime syndicate leader who controls the underworld.
After his father is murdered, he takes over as the head of the organization. Yet, despite everything, Yongde continues to go to work at the company as if nothing has changed.
What is he really thinking…?

title: Poetic Justice
description:
Joo-Heon and Seo Kang-Woo met at a university drinking party, were drawn to each other, and became lovers after a one-night stand . Kang-Woo expected a normal relationship, but Joo-Heon's rough and unruly behavior, seemingly devoid of emotion at crucial moments, ultimately leads to a breakup. 

*"You're the kind of person who can't love anyone, so live alone and never see anyone again."*

Joo-Heon tries to appear calm, but Kang-Woo's absence makes him increasingly worn out, and he finally seeks out Kang-Woo in a precarious state and holds him captive.

 *"I'll fix that, even though I was sometimes harsh. I won't do it again... Just stay like this for ten minutes, no, just one minute."* 

Kang-Woo can't refuse Joo-Heon's desperate plea, almost pathetic, and ends up accepting him. The painful regret and intense love of two people who have lived completely different lives— and the law of cause and effect.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

While delivering documents to a secluded mansion deep in the mountains, she comes face to face with a beautiful man named Tae-hee dragging a corpse, covered in blood. “Why don’t you stay the night and head out tomorrow?” Trying to escape this mysterious man who insists on keeping her there,Yeo-eun flees into the snowy mountain…only to end up in an accident. Until her leg heals and the snow melts, she finds herself stranded alone in the mansion with him. "Shall I make sure you're not bored? " Worn down by loneliness, Yeo-eun can’t help but fall for Tae-hee’s gentle kindness…even though she knows he might be dangerous. But when she finally uncovers a truth, she never wanted to believe, Yeo-eun must make a choice.

title: Radish Controller
description:
With their parents suddenly deciding to live in the countryside, Daeyoung, who went down to the countryside with his elder brother, Daesu, met the sons of their dad's friend, Sunghyeon and Gangjin.
"Daesu's brother is the spare."
"Okay, let him be the goal keeper."
When he was younger, he could still stand alongside his elder brothers as a spare.
A three years age gap was nothing, but the distance between them grew.
Then, one day.
Hearing that the elder brothers were hanging out, Daeyoung secretly joined and went to Sunghyeon's house together, but—
"Ah, bastards. Why the hell are you sneaking in at this time?"
"I came because I was wondering what you were doing. You weren't answering me."
"Fucking annoying. Why did you barge in without telling. Are you brain-dead?"
"What?"
I came to know the "true" side of Sunghyeon who was always kind to me.
[To: Stuckup Scholar
If I find your hideout, I'll let you know!
From: Cute Daeyoung]
Thinking that he had been fooled this entire time, he decided on a cute(?) revenge!
