title: Impurity (Crunchy)
description:
"Unlike your purity, I’m the impure bastard"

Even though she was a bar madam, my mother raised me with love, as if I were just an ordinary child. Because of her, I had to become someone admirable—someone she could be proud of. Even if it meant growing up under the man who abandoned her. I would endure. I had to endure. Until I could grow into a complete human being. I was supposed to keep running without pause.

“You don’t have to love someone to do it.”

“I haven’t even treated you that well. If you lose your composure over just this, what are you going to do?”

Words spoken by a man who was no more than a thug. He wasn’t someone I loved deeply, so why… Why did I feel this strange urge? An urge so strong I wanted to press my body against his.

“Repeat it. Clearly. What did I say I’d do to you?”

“D-Do lewd and… filthy things, like it’s second nature.”

Winter, at sixteen.

That’s when I met Kwon Chahyeok—the man from the most desperate time in my life. He was the beginning, and I foolishly wished he would be the end too. That wish, born from a corrupted heart, might have been the worst decision I could make. Yes. It was love.

A first love, tainted like an impurity.

title: Bad Misconceptions
description:
"You can end it whenever you want, sir. And the more money, the better."

Among the vile men who targeted me, the only one who was different was Seo Kangwoo.

"I want to sleep with you."

I turned him down, thinking that would be the end of it. But when I was standing at the edge of a cliff, I realized, the only thing I had left to offer was myself.

"I told you, once won’t be enough for me. So how much do you want?"

"You can end it whenever you want, sir. And the more money, the better."

"That’s not a bad deal."

His gaze was cold, but the lips that pressed against hers were burning hot. Eunji wondered if the end of this arrangement might be harder than she dared to hope.

Even so, there was only one choice she could make.

title: Sindeurui Seom
description:
***A fantasy action webtoon inspired by the myths of the legendary island of Jeju.*** 

After a great catastrophe, the world is divided into small tribes. Each tribe possesses mysterious individuals known as "Powerful Ones," who serve as both offensive and defensive forces for the tribe. For a long time, wars and conflicts between the tribes continued, but these Powerful Ones intervened and made a pact not to invade each other, leading to a period of lasting peace. A century later, a small tribe in the north proclaims itself the "Nation of the Herd," establishes a "nation," and begins subjugating other tribes by force. The tribes are colonized, and their children are taken away. These children undergo rigorous education and training to become "Fighters" of the Nation of the Herd, and are then deployed in battles to conquer the colony. 

The Fighters subdue the Sanbu Tribe, which boasts two Powerful Ones, and swiftly defeats the surrounding tribes. During a battle with the Wild Tribe, they capture Garo, a boy with the potential for destruction, and Garo's mother, a Powerful One, and subdue the Wild Tribe. Mo-Hun, the youngest prince of the Land of the Herd and a warrior at the forefront of the conquest war, leads Garo and the Fighters on their quest to conquer the Island of the Beginning. Encountering storms and stranding, they eventually reach the Island of the Beginning, where they encounter the Prime Tribe. Living among these people, who have a completely different way of thinking and lifestyle, on the peaceful Island of the Beginning, Mo-Hun, the Fighters, and Garo gradually begin to change. 

Meanwhile, the Land of the Herd succeeds in developing Ancient Power (Explosives), and Prince Kaitan heads to the Island of the Beginning with his army, carrying the explosives. Having set foot on the Island of the Beginning, they launch a war of aggression. The "Those Who Remember the History of the Gods (Simbang)" of the Beginning tribe summon "Gwanegitto (God)" and fight back. And Mo-Hun and the Fighters begin a battle to protect the Primordial Island and the Primordial Tribe against their homeland. On the Primordial Island, a fierce battle unfolds between empire and colony, technology and spirit, invasion and peace, competition and cooperation.

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

title: Sink In (Seol Yi-Young)
description:
“Do you feel guilty thinking I’m Kang Jaehun? I actually like it more.”
Chaeyoung had loved Jaehun quietly for a long time — the kind, confident man who was always warm to everyone.
Even though she knew from the start there was no hope, when she heard the news of Jaehun’s marriage, her heart ached all over again.
In the middle of that unbearable despair, she found herself drawn to Jaejun, Jaehun’s younger brother and her childhood friend.
“What about me? I look just like my brother.”
“Isn’t that good? You’re so obsessed with Jaehun’s face anyway.”
Jaejun’s soft, coaxing voice — paired with a face so similar to Jaehun’s — felt as if he were tempting her on purpose.
“You’re saying you’ll give yourself to me. That’s what you’re saying right now.”
“…We’re friends, aren’t we.”
At those words, Jaejun laughed faintly.
As if to say, she was the only one who ever thought of them as “just friends.”

title: Sabitsuita Ken
description:
On a rainy autumn night, a knight who died under a false accusation opens her eyes again. “Dame Hiderin Viche. Please kill the king.” Hiderin, the resurrected knight, is given only twelve weeks to live—along with a single objective: assassinate the king. …And somehow, raise a child, too. Wandering for a way to complete her mission before time runs out, Hiderin reunites with a holy knight who once despised her. But what happened to the man who used to be so noble and righteous? He’s fallen to rock bottom—a drunken wreck scraping by day to day. “I’m not interested.” “Then what are you interested in?” “You disappearing.” “What a shame. Looks like you won’t get what you want.” Worse still—he’s been missing her. “What good are honor and glory… when she’s not here?” “Dame Viche.” “I told you to call me Hith.” “Am I allowed to?” “Allowed? Just call me Hith. You were doing fine a few hours ago… but after a little drink, you’re a mess. Or was it not ‘a little’?” Sarg hesitates. She’s given him permission to use her nickname, but he isn’t sure he can say it naturally. He’s whispered that name to himself countless times when she wasn’t around—yet in front of her, not even once. Still, he’s always wanted to. So once should be fine. Just once. After a long moment, Sarg finally parts his lips. “…Hiderin.”

description:
"Since we can never go back to being just friends, us." Han Gyeom and Seoyoon, childhood friends who’ve never been apart for even a moment since birth, for 30 years. But their once unshakable bond crumbled overnight because of one reckless mistake. "I liked that day. Didn’t you, too?" "I…" They’re neither lovers nor just friends. Han Gyeom, who wants to keep this ambiguous relationship going, looked unusually bright today. "Make your choice. Either we go on like this, or we never see each other again." "If we can’t stay partners like this, are you saying we should cut ties completely?" Thirty years of friendship were hanging by a thread. Seoyoon’s face turned pale at the weight of those words. "Still confused? Then let’s check again." "Check what?" "Whether I can still be just a friend to you." The moment Seoyoon looked into Han Gyeom’s burning gaze, he realized with certainty— they had already crossed a river they could never return from.

description:
[“I accidentally touched the CEO’s groin while drunk”] Getting drunk is troublesome, but the CEO is even more troublesome. One day after the company party, after drinking just a little too much, with the background, the personality, and the unrealistic CEO and his juniors, Eunwoo ends up in an awkward situation. It’s not the time to be frozen in shock. Eunwoo, having regained consciousness at home, decides to flee before the CEO, who woke up from sleep, notices the incident. The CEO was also clearly drunk enough not to notice, so if Eunwoo pretends not to know, she could get away with it… that was the hope. The CEO, whom she encounters in the elevator while drunk, says, “Why did you go ahead first? Wake me up.” On that day, he knew all the truth. “I know this isn’t an excuse, but I… I was too drunk that day… I’m sorry.” “Well… I don’t know if there’s anything I should apologize for, or if you should be apologizing to me…” “…I thought everything that happened that day was unfortunate.” “Really? Should I say it specifically? Are you apologizing because you feel bad, or because you feel bad for me, or are you just apologizing in general?” The CEO, interpreting the groin incident as responsibility, did not let Eunwoo resign. Not because of modern work ethics, but because, apparently, he meant to date her. Eunwoo, who had no idea, starts a romantic relationship. Life is not easy.

description:

T-Team Leader… this is… I mean, what happened is… No, what I mean is—” As if it wasn’t bad enough that her flawless, perfect boss caught her with a sex toy in her hands… “B-because… this happened because of me, please let me take responsibility— no, please let me be the one to take responsibility…!” “…Are you serious?” She even slipped up and said something insane. Ever since that day, all Ji-yu can see flashing before her eyes is her boss’s… huge XX. She keeps avoiding him around the office, yet she can’t stop remembering what she saw. Unable to hold herself back any longer, Ji-yu finally blurts out: “C-can’t you just… show me one more time?” “…What?” “I know I’m being weird, I swear I know. But after that day… I just keep thinking about yours. I feel like if I see it just one more time, I’ll stop thinking about it… I-I’m really sorry, I’m just losing my mind!” She makes a ridiculous request, acting like she’s gone crazy. But instead of being disgusted, her boss steps closer— as if everything is going exactly as he planned.

Yuni, who graduated from art school without being cured of her "I'm special" disease, faces a society far harsher than a winter cold wave! Realizing that even living an ordinary life isn't easy, let alone being special, Yuni dreams of becoming an "ordinary" office worker, riding the hellish subway, rubbing her sleepy eyes, and drinking Americano...

 *"Life begins with admitting I'm a loser."* 

This is the bittersweet, sweet, and spicy story of a former artist and newbie in the workforce. When will Yuni finally be able to live an "ordinary life"?

(Source: Kakaopage, translated)

title: The Drain
description:
*“Number 11, you keep catching my eye.”*

When a sudden fire breaks out, an omega escapes from the breeding facility and ends up in a gene-trait brothel called 'STUD'. There, in control of Section C, reigns Lee Beomjae. Whether it was bad luck or a single mistake that started it all, he keeps crossing paths with Yoo Jeong-ah (No. 11) - an omega with nothing but his secondary gender to his name. Even when the establishment is shut down for cleaning, or when he’s suddenly dragged to Section A to serve a client, fate seems to throw him in Beomjae’s way again and again. But this isn’t a fairytale forest - it’s a pit of filth. There’s no princess here.

*“I think I’m going to die. I need an alpha. Or at least something I can use, sir… If I can’t right now, I’ll die- I said I’ll die.”  
“...Damn it.”*

No knight is coming to save someone who walked into the mire on his own. Only a monster stands guard - making sure he never escapes. After all, this place is the sewer.

But Yu-na’s life is a complete mess. A mother who sees her only as a cash machine, an agency CEO who treats her like a puppet, and the public’s scornful gaze calling her a “brainless celebrity.” Too bad for them, they picked the wrong person to mess with.

Then appears Kang Tae-hoon, CEO of Hwaja Entertainment and president of JC Group. After meeting Soo-yi’s piercing gaze, he says, “With eyes like that… you can do anything.”

title: To the Unaffectionate You
description:
“She has no charm when she clings to you. She’s nothing but an empty shell.”

At a hotel she visits for a gathering with friends, Han Dajeong runs into her cheating ex-boyfriend. To shake off his shameless persistence, she pretends to be dating a man she happens to meet there—Baek Jundo. At Jundo’s suggestion, the two end up drinking together, and in a moment of impulse, Dajeong spends the night with him.

“I could use a drinking partner.”

“Honestly… I’m not very fun. I’m stiff and boring.”

“Han Dajeong. At the very least—you’ll be fun.”

It’s the first night she truly feels every sensation so vividly. Still, Dajeong decides to treat it as nothing more than a one-night lapse. But strangely enough, Jundo’s insomnia disappears whenever he’s with her. After experiencing deep, restful sleep for the first time in ages, he finds himself wanting to see her again.

“Save my number. There’s something I want to confirm.”

“Listen carefully. You were just a one-night thing to me.”

Believing the relationship is over after coldly pushing him away, Dajeong moves on— Until they meet again.

“I’m Baek Jundo, the newly appointed chairman of Baekun High School. I look forward to working with you, Nurse Han Dajeong.”

Jundo reappears… as the new chairman of the very high school where Dajeong works as a school nurse.

[Original Webtoon](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13478957)

Yet Ho-Beom was the kind of guy who could grasp a sliver of hope even in despair. In the end, for Woon-Oh, who was obsessed with ‘firsts,’ Ho-Beom decided to give him the first he could offer....

title: A White Merman
description:
During the Joseon era, in the island village of Nanyang, far from Hanyang. In this secluded coastal village, Cheong-ok meets Baeki, who is revered as the White Merman and kept confined in a temple for life. When Cheong-ok discovers the terrible secret the village elders have committed against Baeki, she tries to rescue him but fails, and her entire family suffers a brutal punishment. Fortunate to survive, Cheong-ok escapes from Nanyang to wait for the right moment, determined to avenge her family and save Baeki. Years later, as an adult, she returns to Nanyang and infiltrates the temple where Baeki lives, becoming the temple’s night attendant…

description:
The moment I blew out the candles on my 7th birthday cake—

I realized I had reincarnated into the world of a novel. And not just as anyone, but as the daughter of the main characters! The problem is…

[The heroine ■ □ dies, and the male leads… cause the world to end?]

So, in the side stories, my mother dies and my fathers cause the apocalypse? Is this for real…?

‘No way. I’ll stop it no matter what!’

I’m a brave seven-year-old now! So, I set out to lead my fathers and twist the original story by any means possible.

“You know what? You and I are destined to fall in love someday.”

I’m busy enough trying to save my mother, so who the heck are you?

After successfully twisting the original plot, I was planning to finally enjoy my youth, but —

“A son-in-law? Sure. I’ll accept anyone, as long as they meet one condition.”
“What condition?”
“They have to fight us and win.”
“Whatever the reason, any guy who lays a hand on my daughter is as good as dead.”

It seems my fathers have no intention of living peacefully.

“That’s easy. Just tell them to come at me all at once.”

Why are you agreeing to that so casually?!

title: Romance wa Guuzen ni
description:
Unpredictable! What will be the ending of this heart-pounding feeling?

When she gets a “hunch,” she’s right 100% of the time!

Boyoung, known as the “master of hunches,” is a couple manager who ranks first in matching success thanks to her almost supernatural sixth sense.

But, as the saying goes, “a monk can’t shave his own head.” Her own love life fails again and again. On top of that, because those hunches come to her anytime and anywhere, people often treat her like a strange person. That is why her first meeting with Eungi was, in short, a complete disaster.

A handsome face, but a personality that doesn’t match.

Eungi, famous as a divorce lawyer, does not believe in love, which he considers nothing more than an empty emotion, after witnessing the unhappy end of his parents’ marriage during his childhood.

Then, while handling a divorce case, Eungi is attacked by a stranger and loses his memory. When he sees Boyoung, who comes to visit him at the hospital, his heart begins to race like crazy.

When his memories suddenly return upon seeing her, Eungi starts looking for her every day, using his memory as an excuse. However, at the same time, he hurls cruel words at her, saying that “once he regains his memory, this heart-pounding feeling will disappear too”...

What will be the ending of this romance that began by chance?

I Refuse an Ending Where My Mother Dies!
The Ending Where the Mother Dies Is a Disaster!

description:
The moment I blew out the candles on my 7th birthday cake—

I realized I had reincarnated into the world of a novel. And not just as anyone, but as the daughter of the main characters! The problem is…

[The heroine ■ □ dies, and the male leads… cause the world to end?]

So, in the side stories, my mother dies and my fathers cause the apocalypse? Is this for real…?

‘No way. I’ll stop it no matter what!’

I’m a brave seven-year-old now! So, I set out to lead my fathers and twist the original story by any means possible.

“You know what? You and I are destined to fall in love someday.”

I’m busy enough trying to save my mother, so who the heck are you?

After successfully twisting the original plot, I was planning to finally enjoy my youth, but —

“A son-in-law? Sure. I’ll accept anyone, as long as they meet one condition.”
“What condition?”
“They have to fight us and win.”
“Whatever the reason, any guy who lays a hand on my daughter is as good as dead.”

It seems my fathers have no intention of living peacefully.

“That’s easy. Just tell them to come at me all at once.”

Why are you agreeing to that so casually?!

But who are you?” A casino dealer known as Chloe is tasked with seducing a man who is still searching for his lover who died eight years ago— all to retrieve a certain item. ‘If I fail, Mama Kwan’s treatment will be for nothing.’ Her face, her voice, even her scent— everything about her reminds him of Lee Seulbi. Yet every circumstance insists that she is not the woman he’s looking for. “Fine. Go ahead.” “Do what?” “What you were planning to do to me.” Trusting his instincts, Doha willingly throws himself into the biggest gamble of his life— betting everything he has.
Source: MU

description:
Hwiyeon has spent countless years cultivating the Way and accumulating virtue with a single goal: to ascend as a dragon and become a god. But becoming a god requires recognition; only when a sentient being acknowledges Hwiyeon, an imugi, as a god can he truly become one.

Then...

*“Wow, what a pretty snake.”*

With a single remark from Gang-a, the young heir of the family that has served Hwiyeon for generations over hundreds of years, everything Hwiyeon has built up vanishes like smoke.

Enraged, Hwiyeon refrains from tearing everyone apart and killing them. Instead, he takes Gang-a away from his family, hoping for another chance to have him call Hwiyeon a god.

Yet as they spend time together, Hwiyeon’s initial hatred gradually begins to fade...

And as the years pass, Hwiyeon starts to feel a strange sense of déjà vu around Gang-a, now grown into adulthood.

_Source: BOMTOON, translated_
